item.title: Harry Styles Demonstrates the Power of Dancing & His Little Red Shorts in Playful ‘Dance No More’ Music Video
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to Trending on Billboard. I'm your host, and today we're talking about the one and only Harry Styles. His new music video for "Dance No More" is out now, and it's got everyone moving.
[Short music clip from "Dance No More" plays]
Host: The video premiered on YouTube on May 7th, and it's a non-stop dance party from start to finish. Harry Styles sings and dances his way through the song, wearing a pair of eye-catching red shorts that are sure to grab your attention.
[Clip of Harry Styles singing plays]
Host: The video starts with Harry walking into a room where his band is waiting, and things quickly take off from there. The crowd can't help but jump out of their seats and join in on the fun, drawn in by Harry's infectious energy and dance moves.
[Clip of crowd dancing plays]
Host: This is the third music video from Harry's latest album, "Kiss All the Time. Disco, Occasionally", which spent two weeks at number one on the Billboard 200. And if you're a fan, you won't want to miss his upcoming "Together, Together" tour, which kicks off in Amsterdam in just a few weeks.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for today. Check out the "Dance No More" music video now, and get ready to dance along with Harry Styles. Thanks for tuning in to Trending on Billboard.
